behaviors.description: Install and launch the missing authenticator from its signal handler, then resume protected resolution.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent protected runtime, a runnable authenticator app and its gio runtime; all refs and the service initially absent.
behaviors.expected: Refusal fails without downloads or deployments; acceptance installs the exact candidate through a native nested transaction, launches that app, authenticates the exact request, and deploys the protected commit with an authorized token.

behaviors.description: Report and decline installation of a missing authenticator.
behaviors.preconditions: Independently prepared protected runtime and available candidate app on the autoinstall branch; neither is installed.
behaviors.expected: install-authenticator supplies exact remote and candidate ref on the transaction thread; returning without installation causes transaction failure, no protected download and no deployments.

mappings.rationale: Both refusal and acceptance are exercised. Native signal payloads, nested installation and transaction resumption are asserted; the newly installed sandboxed service supplies the token needed by the independent protected HTTP repository.
The signal payload and refusal outcome are asserted. Successful installation and resumed authentication are not established, so the full behavior obligation remains unmapped.

surface_assertions.rationale: Exact remote/ref and callback thread are checked; leaving the candidate uninstalled fails the transaction before protected downloads or deployments.

notes: Older fixture manifests with a placeholder candidate support refusal only. Successful installation requires the new runnable authenticator binary and its independently exported runtime. CLI launch and inspection are observers and earn no library launch coverage.
